description: Offline 3D cube puzzle from 2×2 to 20×20 with timer, solver and hints Twist Cubee is a fast, beautiful 3D cube puzzle that works completely offline. Every size Play cubes from 2×2×2 all the way up to 20×20×20. Every size keeps its own saved game, so you can come back to a half-solved 9×9 whenever you like. Natural controls • Drag across the cube to turn a layer. The sticker under your finger follows it, and a quick flick finishes the turn. • Drag the background, or use two fingers anywhere, to spin the whole cube freely. • Pinch to zoom and twist to roll. Double-tap to reset the view. • A lock button stops accidental rotation. Speedcubing tools • Animated scramble, then a timer that starts with your first move. • Optional 15-second WCA-style inspection. • Statistics for every size: best time, average, Ao5, fewest moves and recent solves. Help when you are stuck • Hints on 2×2 and 3×3 say what to do in plain words ("Turn the green face clockwise") and wiggle the layer to turn. • Auto-solve uses an optimal 2×2 solver and Kociemba's two-phase algorithm for the 3×3 (about 20 moves). Bigger cubes rewind your moves. Make it yours Stickerless or classic stickers, four color schemes (including a color-blind-friendly one), three body colors, four backgrounds, and animation speed. Private by design No internet permission, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your progress never leaves your device. Light and fast A tiny app (under 300 KB) with a native OpenGL ES 3.0 renderer. It draws even a 20×20 cube with a handful of GPU calls, and uses no battery when the cube is still.
